verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document a general reusable-template feature for recurring kinds of notes, nor variables like date or title inserted when applying one. The only template-like item is the `:quick-capture-templates` config for the logseq:// quick-capture protocol (with {time}, {text} and {url} placeholders). That only formats incoming quick-capture text, so it is an adjacent feature rather than reusable note templates. Automatic daily Journals pages are likewise not user-defined templates.
